title: Microsoft Just Offered 60,000 Buyouts. Are Layoffs Really Rising?
description:
Microsoft just offered buyouts to about 60,000 employees, roughly a quarter of its workforce. So are layoffs really surging? The government's own data tells a very different story.

Penny the coin breaks down the job market with official data: what a buyout is (and why so few people take one), whether layoffs are really rising, weekly jobless claims, how we got here, the real problem (hiring has slowed way down), the great stay, tech jobs and AI, which industry is still hiring, two numbers to watch for a recession, and what it all means for you.

Microsoft buyouts: CNBC, TechCrunch, Deadline and Fortune reports, October 26-28, 2026.

This video is for education only and is not financial advice.
